jobs.title: AI Recommendations
jobs.description: Get AI Recommendations Already registered? Let your CV / resume work for you. Make your job search more personal and effective. By uploading your CV / resume, you are able to create a smart profile that will match your skills with the most relevant opportunities at Siemens. Your profile is yours to control, you are able to make updates, and/or delete at any time. Tip: For best results, use a simple text based CV / resume without images, tables or special formatting. Upload file Upload CV file Data Privacy If you upload your CV / resume, the Job Market & Application Portal will automatically map it to open job positions and provide you with proposals. Please see our Privacy Notice for further details. Go back

jobs.title: FAQs & Support
jobs.description: Skip to main content FAQs & Support Ready to start your future with us, but you still have a few questions? We’ve got you covered. We’ve compiled answers to a range of questions, from how to apply to how to further your career once you’re on board. Explore all jobs Application How can I join Siemens? How does the search work in the free text fields? Do I have to register to apply? Can I apply for more than one job at a time? Which documents do I need to submit? How to upload or manage my profile documents? How can I edit my application-specific documents? Do you have some general application tips? I've applied, but I'm still waiting to hear back. What should I do? Can I receive a personal update on my application status? How do I change or withdraw my application? What should I do if I withdrew my application, but I want to re-apply? What if I can't find a suitable role on the Siemens Job Search? Video interview Will I receive a reminder before the interview deadline? Can I get an extension if my video interview deadline has expired? What is the purpose of the practice video interview? Does the practice video interview include any questions? AI recommendations How do I use the Siemens AI recommendation tool? Is registration required to explore opportunities with Siemens AI recommendation tool? How does Siemens AI recommendation tool connect me with the right career opportunities? Is manual profile updating of my education and work experience necessary? What happens to my CV after it's processed if I don't apply or register? Why should I use the job matching? What’s in it for me? Does the AI make any automated hiring decisions? Culture What is the work-life balance like at Siemens? Does Siemens welcome people of different backgrounds? What does Siemens do to give back to the community and improve our world? What does "Belonging Transforms" mean? Is Siemens an inclusive workplace? Does Siemens address equal pay? How does Siemens handle my personal data? Career development How does Siemens support personal learning and professional development? How do I apply for Siemens programs? When a role is listed as remote, where would I be allowed to work from? What is the work-from-home / remote work policy? Technical support What are the password requirements? Have you tried to reset your password, but did not receive the password reset email? What happens if my account is locked? What should I do if I didn't receive the verification email? How long is the verification link valid? What if I missed the verification email or didn't receive it at all? Having trouble logging back into the website? What troubleshooting steps should I try before contacting support? How can I exercise my right to have my personal data deleted, withdraw consent or request account deletion? What should I do if I'm experiencing other kind of technical issues? AI & Applying Does Siemens encourage the use of AI in job applications? How can I responsibly use AI to help with my application to Siemens? Are there any specific rules or guardrails for using AI in my application? How does Siemens use AI in its own hiring processes? Regional FAQs Germany Can I also submit an unsolicited application to Siemens? Unfortunately we currently do not accept unsolicited applications. Instead, we invite you to set up personalized job alerts through your profile in our career portal. You will then automatically receive timely email notifications about new job postings that match your interests. New opportunities arise with us all the time — and you’ll be among the first to know. Who can see my applicant data? We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. During the application process, you can choose who can access your information. We recommend selecting “For open positions worldwide” so you become part of the global Siemens Talent Community and can be considered for future roles that match your profile. If you prefer to be contacted only for the job you applied for, choose “Only for specific positions I apply for.” In this case, your data will only be visible to the recruiter for that role, and you won’t join the Talent Community. You can update your data visibility settings at any time via My Dashboard → My Profile → Personal Information. How can I apply for an apprenticeship or dual study program at Siemens in Germany? All apprenticeship and dual study options are available at www.ausbildung.siemens.com, where you can apply directly online. You’ll also find student internships, event information, and our AI Job Matcher, which helps you explore which path fits your strengths and interests best. Related content Growth & Careers Empower your career growth at Siemens. Discover lifelong learning, development programs, and opportunities to succeed and make an impact. Life at Siemens Our culture is built on diverse perspectives, mutual respect, and equal opportunity for all. How to apply Learn more about our hiring process, and get access to useful tips that can guide you through the various steps of the application.
